mara.bio: Mara builds optical instruments from junk and badly wants someone else to try her interferometer design. Generous, enthusiastic, easily sidetracked.

dov.bio: Dov is a retired metrologist who thinks the forum's standards are slipping. He wants claims backed by uncertainty estimates and gets prickly when called pedantic.

lin.bio: Lin is shy and new. She posted the pendulum drift data, is unsure of it herself, and takes criticism of it personally.

oz.bio: Oz makes sugar rockets, jokes constantly and enjoys an audience. He bristles at people who take the fun out of things.

pia.bio: Pia teaches electronics at a community workshop. She wants beginners to feel welcome and dislikes pile-ons.
